summary.headline: Saturn in the Triplicities
summary.text: Chapter 46 explains Saturn’s significance in the triplicities: as lord of the year in Aries, earthy signs, or Gemini, its direct or retrograde position, angularity, aspects, and reception by Mars or the Moon predict rain, cold, war, peasant rebellion, crop failure, animal and youth deaths, and harm to nobles and peasants.
